audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer's own win array gives Malphite six of seven stages including First item and 2+ items, while the prose directly beneath says 'Once Kassadin hits two items he reclaims this lane outright and there is no honest way around it' and whys[6] says 'play frontline, not duelist'. The packet's levelChart for this matchup disagrees with the stored win array as well, showing Kassadin owning the back half.
audit.why: 51.04% over 960 games is a coinflip that front-loads to Malphite: he is stronger levels 1-6 and loses the scaling race outright. Marking First item and 2+ items as Malphite wins contradicts both the prose and the champion's actual scaling.
audit.corrected: First item and 2+ items should read Kassadin. Blocked from proposing the flip — see notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike says to cash your R 'before his Riftwalk stacks are cheap' without ever giving the number that makes the advice usable.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s. At rank 1 that is a 5-second window between blinks — genuinely punishable. At rank 3 it is 2 seconds, which is why the lane closes so hard. Malphite's Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s against that, so you get roughly one attempt per wave state and he gets a blink every few seconds. Force Pulse is his other real cooldown at 21/20/19/18/17s.
audit.corrected: The 5s-versus-2s spread added so 'cash it early' has a concrete meaning.

audit.whatIsWrong: Null Sphere is called a silence in five places across the content layer — 'His Q silence', 'Q silence + magic shield', 'he silences you'. Kassadin's Q has no silence. Worse, the page uses that fabricated silence to explain why Malphite's poke does nothing, so the reader learns the wrong reason for a correct observation.
audit.why: Riot's text for Null Sphere: damage, interrupts channels, and a shield that absorbs MAGIC damage. No silence anywhere. The real explanation the page is missing is his passive: Void Stone reduces the magic damage he takes, and Ground Slam deals magic damage based on Malphite's armour while Seismic Shard is magic too. So Kassadin's passive AND his Q shield both specifically blunt Malphite's entire damage output — that is the defining interaction of the matchup and it is why stacking armour raises your damage far less here than in other lanes. Second missing piece: Force Pulse charges from spells cast in his vicinity, so your own poke rotation is what arms his slow. Third: Nether Blade is a 7s auto-attack reset, so the wind-up is the burst tell.
audit.corrected: Silence removed everywhere and replaced with Void Stone's magic reduction plus Null Sphere's magic shield; Force Pulse's charging mechanic and Nether Blade's reset added.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kassadin.json (P: 'takes reduced magic damage'; Q: shield 'absorbs magic damage', no silence)
champ-data/_kits/malphite.json (E: 'magic damage based on his Armor')

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns in either layer despite nine repetitions of 'track Riftwalk'.
audit.why: Riftwalk at 5/3.5/2s is not a cooldown you wait out — it is a cooldown you race. Force Pulse at 21/20/19/18/17s is the genuinely long one, and it only comes up if you have been casting spells near him.
audit.corrected: Both numbers added, with the point that Riftwalk is raced rather than waited out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization says 'Iceborn Gauntlet / Frozen Heart (by his AD profile), then Thornmail' against a full-AP burst mage — and the content layer already says outright that 'your armor stacking does nothing against full-AP burst', so the two layers openly disagree.
audit.why: Kassadin is magic damage end to end. Armour and Thornmail are dead stats. Mercury's Treads is already right. The genuine tension worth stating: Ground Slam scales off armour, but Void Stone reduces the magic damage it deals, so armour is doubly devalued in this specific lane.
audit.corrected: MR core, and the armour-versus-Void-Stone tension stated instead of left implicit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Your Unstoppable Force' and 'Seismic Shard's' as suspect names — both are false positives and correct. The genuine name problem is the invented silence on Null Sphere, which the packet's checker could not catch because it looks for misspellings, not fabricated effects.
audit.why: Null Sphere, Nether Blade, Force Pulse, Riftwalk and Void Stone are the real names, and not one of them appears in the content layer — it says only 'his Q', 'his magic shield', 'his blink'.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout the edited strings.

notes: Null Sphere is described as a SILENCE in five places across the content layer. Kassadin's Q has no silence — Riot's text is damage, channel interrupt, and a shield absorbing magic damage. The page used that invented silence to explain why Malphite's poke does nothing, so a correct observation was attached to a fabricated cause. The real cause, absent from both layers, is that Void Stone reduces the magic damage he takes while Ground Slam and Seismic Shard are both magic — his passive and his Q shield each specifically blunt Malphite's entire output, which is also why armour stacking pays less here than in any other lane.
